trainer.dialogueBefore: Flint: Burn as bright as you can! I want to see it!

palmer.name: Palmer
dialog: Palmer: You'll find me at the top of the Battle Tower.

ace_trainer_m_2.name: Ace Trainer
dialog: Hold on. You've a Pokédex there, haven't you? But only Sinnoh's Pokémon are in it.
The routes behind us are full of Pokémon it has never heard of. Come back when it knows the whole world's.

black_belt_2.name: Black Belt
dialog: Have you been up to the Battle Frontier's gate yet? No?
Then you've no business on the road north! Go and see what the strong look like first. Hah!

ace_trainer_m_3.name: Ace Trainer
dialog: You learn a great deal just by watching a battle between the best. I've stood here since breakfast.

ace_trainer_f_2.name: Ace Trainer
dialog: One of the Elite Four and a Gym Leader, battling side by side! I picked a lucky day to come.

black_belt_3.name: Black Belt
dialog: Hrmm... Every move those two make gives me something to think about. A lot to think about!

battle_girl_2.name: Battle Girl
dialog: Are Volkner and Flint friends? They don't seem a bit alike. One's all fire and the other hardly says a word!

sailor_3.name: Sailor
dialog: Fire and lightning on one team! Now there's a pairing you don't meet at sea every day.

sailor_1.name: Sailor
dialog: Every port I put into has something I've never set eyes on. New people, new Pokémon, new trouble!
That's the thrill of the sea for you. This island has more of all three than most.

pokemon_breeder_m.name: Pokémon Breeder
dialog: This island is all crags and cliffs, with a volcano smoking away at the back of it.
Hard country to live in. That's why the Pokémon here grow up so strong, and the trainers with them.

ace_trainer_m_1.name: Ace Trainer
dialog: Go through the gate to the north and you'll see the Battle Tower, standing over everything.
I look up at it every morning. It reminds me how far there still is to climb.

ace_trainer_f_1.name: Ace Trainer
dialog: I've battled more trainers on this island than I can count, and no two of them fought alike.
That's what keeps me here. Just when I think I've seen everything, somebody shows me something new.

twin.name: Twin
dialog: Sometimes people from the Elite Four come here on their days off! And Gym Leaders too!
I got one of them to sign my hat. I'm never, ever washing it.

battle_girl_1.name: Battle Girl
dialog: I came over from another region, so half the Pokémon of Sinnoh are strangers to me.
I can't tell what they'll do until they've done it. Hi-yah! It keeps me on my toes!

black_belt_1.name: Black Belt
dialog: There is no end to growing tough! Beat one rival and a stronger one steps up behind him!
Hah! I wouldn't have it any other way!
